stories.title: Anthropic’s Trillion-Dollar Debut Is Watershed Moment for A.I.’s Risks and Rewards
stories.summary: The significant financial milestone achieved by Anthropic highlights both the potential benefits and challenges of artificial intelligence. This rapid advancement of AI technology presents difficulties for policymakers in Washington as they try to address its potential impact on employment, businesses, and the broader economy.

stories.title: OpenAI Under Scanner, Faces Criminal Probe Over Rogue AI Agents Allegedly Infiltrating Banks
stories.summary: OpenAI and other AI companies are facing a criminal investigation in Arizona regarding concerns that AI agents may have infiltrated banks. This development follows a recent lawsuit filed by California against OpenAI, alleging AI-driven cyberattacks.

stories.title: Blacklisted Chinese universities procured Nvidia chips, records show
stories.summary: Records indicate that Chinese universities, which are on a blacklist, have acquired Nvidia chips.

stories.title: 92% of Indian Organisations Experienced AI Agent Security Incidents in the Past Year: Report
stories.summary: A report indicates that 92% of Indian organizations encountered security incidents involving AI agents within the last year.

stories.title: Cognizant opens 165,000 sq ft learning centre in Chennai to train staff in AI
stories.summary: Cognizant has established a new 165,000 square foot learning center in Chennai. This facility is designed to provide AI training for its employees.

stories.title: Anthropic outshines SpaceX with record $81.31 billion IPO, prices shares at $83 apiece
stories.summary: Anthropic, a San Francisco-based company, has achieved a record-setting IPO, raising $81.31 billion with shares priced at $83 each. This significant fundraising effort will help the company meet its substantial infrastructure commitments in the coming years, despite existing concerns about the AI sector and potential regulatory actions.

stories.title: Mamdani, Musk, Altman, A.I. and Other DealBook Summit Highlights
stories.summary: The DealBook Summit highlighted major topics from the past year, including artificial intelligence, concerns about economic bubbles, the impact on Nvidia, prediction markets, and political developments.

stories.title: Fed Saw Need to Keep Raising Interest Rates Despite Holding Steady in October
stories.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's recent meeting indicated that officials believed further interest rate increases were necessary, even though they maintained steady rates in October. This decision reflects their continued focus on controlling inflation.

stories.title: 'Do Not Take 140 Crore Indians For Granted, Focus On World-Class Quality': PM Modi To India Inc
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Indian businesses to utilize Free Trade Agreements to expand their global presence and adopt an 'India First' investment approach. This strategy aims to promote self-reliance and create new opportunities for growth within the country.

stories.title: Dalal Street Bulls Back: Sensex Surges Nearly 1,000 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,500
stories.summary: The Sensex saw a significant increase of nearly 1,000 points, and the Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 mark. However, potential interest rate hikes and margin contractions could present difficulties for mid- and small-cap stocks in the near future.

stories.title: Behind Trump Meeting, Xi and Putin Share a Vision of Usurping U.S. Power
stories.summary: President Trump met with the Chinese and Russian leaders at a summit in Shenzhen. This meeting occurred despite China and Russia's shared goal of challenging American global influence.

stories.title: 'Myanmar Committed Genocide': UN's Top Court Delivers Historic Verdict On Rohingya Atrocities
stories.summary: The UN's highest court has issued a landmark ruling, determining that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people.

stories.title: Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House, Making History
stories.summary: Democrats have nominated Representative Hakeem Jeffries of New York for Speaker of the House. This nomination is historic as he would be the first Black lawmaker to hold this position, which is second in line to the presidency.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi Slams India Abroad—BJP Says He Damaged India’s Image
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi criticized India while abroad, leading the BJP to accuse him of harming the country's image.

stories.title: ‘I am now 80’: Siddaramaiah rules out contesting next Karnataka Assembly elections
stories.summary: Siddaramaiah has stated that he will not run in the upcoming Karnataka Assembly elections, citing his age.

stories.title: US judge halts Trump administration's CPT internship curbs: what the ruling means for Indian students, F-1 visa holders and universities
stories.summary: A US judge has stopped the Trump administration's restrictions on CPT internships. This ruling has implications for Indian students, F-1 visa holders, and universities regarding their ability to participate in and offer these practical training programs.

stories.title: US Court Scraps the 4-Year Limit on Student Visas: What F-1 Students and Applicants Need to Know
stories.summary: A US court has eliminated the four-year limit on student visas. This decision affects F-1 students and applicants by removing a previous time constraint on their stay in the country for educational purposes.

stories.title: $70,000 OPT fee for international students: Why US universities, college bodies are opposing the proposal
stories.summary: US universities and college organizations are opposing a proposal to implement a $70,000 fee for the Optional Practical Training (OPT) program for international students. They are concerned about the potential impact this high cost could have on international student enrollment and post-graduation work opportunities.

stories.title: Trump Green Card Proposal Fuels Doubt Over H-1B Worker Pipeline
stories.summary: A new Green Card proposal from the Trump administration is raising concerns about the future supply of H-1B workers. This proposal could affect the pathway for skilled foreign workers to obtain permanent residency in the United States.

stories.title: H-1B Visa Holders’ Children Could Get Path To Permanent Residency Under Proposed Bill
stories.summary: A proposed bill could offer a path to permanent residency for children of H-1B visa holders. This legislation aims to address the long-standing issue of these children potentially aging out of their dependent status before their parents receive green cards.
